conditions: standard_user signs in, adds a product, checks out with valid details, clicks Finish on the overview page
items.expected: The Finish button is clicked and the overview page transitions; the page displays a thank-you message (e.g. 'Thank you for your order!')

conditions: error_user signs in, adds a product, checks out with valid details, attempts to click Finish on the overview page
items.expected: The page displays the thank-you message — currently known broken; test is expected to fail

conditions: standard_user completes the order by clicking Finish; then navigates to the cart
items.expected: The Finish button completes the order (thank-you page is shown); the cart badge is not shown and the cart contents are empty

conditions: standard_user completes the order, then clicks the Back Home button on the confirmation page
items.expected: The Back Home button is clicked and the confirmation page transitions; the product list page is displayed

conditions: standard_user completes checkout and reaches the confirmation/thank-you page; axe-core scans the page with WCAG 2 A/AA rules
items.expected: No accessibility violations are reported (violations list is empty)

excluded.reason: Story #117 covers the confirmation page only — no credentials are entered, no session management occurs, and no data-protection decisions are made on this page. There is no browser-observable security behaviour distinct from the functional tests.
Bug #121 (problem user sees the same picture for every product) touches the product list display, not the order completion flow. It has no overlap with AC-1, AC-2 or AC-3 of this story.
